name: Elrond of the White Council
oracle_text: Secret council — When Elrond enters, each player secretly votes for fellowship or aid, then those votes are revealed. For each fellowship vote, the voter chooses a creature they control. You gain control of each creature chosen this way, and they gain "This creature can't attack its owner." Then for each aid vote, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

needs.what: a vote op over named options (here 'fellowship' / 'aid'), every player voting, secretly and revealed simultaneously (secret council), that binds each voter's choice so later effects can (a) run per fellowship voter, with that voter choosing a creature they control, and (b) read the count of aid votes as an amount (repeat add_counters of +1/+1 on each creature you control once per aid vote)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode and choose_player are one player's choice; for_each_player wrapping choose_mode has no way to bind each player's chosen option for later reading, and no value_key counts votes for an option; join_forces collects mana payments, not choices
